description: This Java source file implements an immutable class 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl' which extends an abstract class and implements an interface related to modifying feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to create instances, access feature properties, set headers, and generate response builders.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommand', providing concrete methods for modifying feature definitions in a live command context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance from a generic Command object, casted to a ModifyFeatureDefinition.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature identifier associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is 'MODIFY'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; always returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of this object.
